summary.text: Jeff Sorrells, a Republican, has represented Alabama House District 87 since November 7, 2018, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He graduated from Troy University with a B.A. and later from the Samford University Community Bankers School of Banking.
He served as vice president and lender of First National Bank of Hartford and has sat on the Wiregrass Economic Development Corporation board and the Geneva County Gas District board.
